pre_condition: prompt is a non-empty string. files is a list of string file paths (may be empty).
post_condition:
When files is empty, returns prompt unchanged. When files is non-empty, returns a string consisting of the literal prefix 'Read these file(s) before acting:
', followed by one line per element of files in input order where each line has the form '- <path>' and <path> is the element's string value, followed by '

' and the prompt string. Every element of files appears exactly once in the returned string. The returned string contains no characters beyond those derived from these components.
